name: final1_v2_reg
hypothesis: FINAL 1 (20 min, s3d_v2, pre-registered rule): FINE-TUNE of the v1 regression weights + chroma_proj (no new hues) with the run-2 regression recipe on s3d_v2's complete train scenarios (198 at start, 3 cameras each; hold-out = last 12 scenarios), 80-sequence GPU chunks swapped every 2 min. Two from-scratch attempts were aborted at 1-2.4 steps/s (GPU shared with the v2 build, app3d.compare, native tests: 11-15.6 of 16 GB), too few steps for a from-scratch run. Data lever: if more data helps, the hold-out curve should keep improving well past the ~5-min optimum seen on s3d_v1, and beat P (v1) on its hold-out (P: l1 0.990x, ms_dssim 0.977x lr, spectrum 0.169, midband -0.258).
